# Calculate All

Calculate All is a free all-in-one online calculator library — 176 calculators for money, health, dates, home projects, school and everyday life. Calculate All calculates percentages, loan payments, grades, health numbers and project materials; it has nothing to do with numerology.

Made for anyone with a number to check — students, shoppers, homeowners, workers and small businesses.

All 176 calculators are free, with no account or sign-up. Every calculator shows its formula or method and at least one worked example.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://calculateall.site/): all 176 calculators, organized by category.
- [Embed these calculators](https://calculateall.site/embed.html): put any of the 176 Calculate All calculators on your own site for free — no account, no attribution required.
- [Partnerships](https://calculateall.site/partnerships.html): the network Calculate All belongs to, and how to partner with us.
- [Creator ROI Hub — Earnings, Sponsorship & Fee Calculators](https://calculateall.site/creator-roi-calculators.html): The Creator ROI Hub: free calculators for people who publish for a living — YouTube and TikTok earnings, sponsorship rates, payment fees and AI API costs, with honest ranges and the math shown.
